d: When Eliza is told that Jake is the last one of his kind, she can't just let his species become another member upon the extinction list.

Eliza goes through desperate measures to help animals survive during these tough times along the Skeleton Coast.  However, the price she pays for her good-will intentions will soon cost her family's entire holiday cheer.

st: Black and White and Mom All Over
d: When a seemingly abandoned panda bear imprints on Debbie, Eliza doubts Debbie's  parenting ability until a monsoon convinces Eliza that Debbie can handle more than she lets on.
When Eliza reunites with a Siberian Tiger, she is stunned when the tiger turns on her. Eliza's visiting Grandma Sophie helps her overcome her fears just as she is overcoming her own.

Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach.  Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense.  Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way.  She turns out to be Grandma.

Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends.  They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine.  She performs the new act, but it's boring.
Arnold and Helga perform a \"Romeo and Juliet\"- type play for a school production
At the Parent's Day competition, Arnold learns that even though he doesn't have \"real\" parents, his grandparents are just as good as everyone else's parents.

Eugene's Birthday: Arnold is the cause of two birthday party's for Eugene being a big flop.
Stinky's Pumpkin: Stinky feels that he is a failure at everything he does until Arnold helps him discover that he is the best pumpkin grower in town.

t: Hey Arnold!: Dinner for Four/Phoebe Skips
d:
Dinner for Four: After winning coupons to a fancy French restaurant, Helga attempts to prove to Arnold that she is more sophisticated than Lila. 
Phoebe Skips: Helga is devastated when her patsy, Phoebe, is skipped to the 6th grade.

st: The Doctor Is In/The Big Sneeze
d: Angelica plays radio psychologist to the babies, but her advice backfires in `The Doctor Is In', and then in `The Big Sneeze', Chuckie is worried that he might be allergic to Kimi.

st: The Fun Way Day/The Age of Aquarium
d: In order to drum up more business, Kira hires a Feng Shui expert to rearrange the coffee shop./The entire gang goes to the cheesy local aquarium for the day, which is shaped like a huge boat.

When the mommies leave the babies with their fathers, all hell breaks loose at home./Angelica tells the babies that the reason her new doll is so realistic is that it's actually a real baby that was turned into a doll.

Chas and Kira take on a teen to help around the coffee shop. "Cyndy" is a dead ringer for Angelica's Cynthia doll./In order to impress some four-year old girls with a "thing" for babies, Angelica promises to be nice to the Rugrats forever.

To celebrate Boris and Minka's anniversary, the whole gang takes a train trip to Little Biendeltown, a theme park recreation of the Old Country. The scenic 18-hour journey is a send-up of Agatha Christie-style mysteries.

When Didi decides to go "back to school", Angelica explains that soon Tommy will be a baby like Dil again./ Chas and Kira pursue their dream of owning a coffee shop while the Rugrats pursue their own dream - or, rather, Chuckie's dream.
When Donnie kidnaps an aye-aye for a pet, Eliza must return the bad luck omen to his home before the villagers hunt it down.
When the Commvee is surrounded by angry seals, Eliza tries to use her own methods to get them to move, but she learns from her Inuit friend, Jim that traditional ways have their value.
When Kip and Biederman cause an oil spill, Eliza must save her sea otter friends.
The Thornberrys meet the Kung people of Africa. Debbie amazes them by speaking perfect click talk. Jealous of Debbie, Eliza tries to prove she is just as special.

When the Thornberrys visit Nigel's friend Jomo, they search for an elephant, Rebecca, that Nigel saved twenty years ago. As the family attends to an elephant stuck in a mudhole, Eliza bonds with Rebecca.
When Eliza accidentally reads Debbie's diary she learns that Debbie thinks she's an embarrassment of a sister. Debbie and Eliza have it out and learn the real truth about their sistership.

Full moon: When the gang all decide that they are going to "moon" Principal Wartz, Arnold thinks that it's a bad idea, but ends up inadvertently getting caught and taking the blame.
Student Teacher: Olga comes to PS 118 to be a student teacher.

t: Hey Arnold!: Big Gino/Jamie O in Luv
d:
Big Gino: Sid gets in over his head when doing business with the local kid loan shark, Big Gino.
Jamie O in Luv: Gerald's big brother, Jamie O, falls for a girl and suddenly turns nice to his kid brother.

t: Hey Arnold!: Beeper Queen/Oscar Can't Read?
d:
Beeper Queen: Big Bob pulls his back and cannot go to a very important meeting. Not knowing who else to send in his place, he asks Helga.
Oscar Can't Read?: When Arnold discovers that Oskar has been pretending to know how to read, Arnold confronts him.

t: Hey Arnold!: The Headless Cabbie/Friday the 13th
d:
The Headless Cabbie: Wolfgang dares Arnold and the gang to break superstitions, which causes a spate of bad luck to erupt.
Friday the 13th: At a sleepover, Arnold and the boys sit around and tell scary stories.

Helga's Parrot: Big Bob gets a pesky parrot he passes to Helga, who confides in it about Arnold.
Chocolate Turtles: Arnold and Gerald sell chocolate turtles to fund their go-cart project.

t: Hey Arnold!: Love and Cheese/Weighing Harold
d:
Love and Cheese: Arnold goes all out to win Lila's affection by taking her to the Annual Cheese Festival.
Weighing Harold: Harold feels that he has gotten too fat, so he gets his parents to send him on a weight-off cruise.

st: A Step At A Time/Angelica's Assistant
d: The babies try and make Dil take his first steps so he can play a game with them. The adults - and the babies - reminiscence about each of the Rugrats' first steps. / Charlotte sets a playdate for Angelica with bumbling preschool classmate Harold.

st: Tale of Two Puppies/Okey Dokey Jones and the Ring of Sunbeans
d: Chuckie decides to teach a puppy, "Puppy," to be brave so that she'll be adopted into a good home./Grandpa Lou takes the babies to an exotic pet shop, and the babies go on an Indiana Jones-type adventure to rescue Lil's ring from Angelica.

The babies are worried that their new babysitter, a teen-angst wannabe rocker named Taffy, is unhappy because she sings such sad songs./Angelica coerces the Rugrats to take roles in her make-believe game based on her favorite TV show, "The Cynthia Team".
The entire gang heads to Club Fred for some rest and relaxation. Once in paradise, the babies must find Bluebeard's treasure to save the holiday for everyone.

Betty's relatives from England come to America for a visit. With them are their kids, Smedley and Hedley, who are also fraternal twins like Phil and Lil. Unlike Phil and Lil, these twins behave properly.
